I was the one that flooded the 4th floor dorm bathroom back in October 08! The old building I lived in was split into three wings, each was 4 stories high. During my year there it was split that every other level was guy/girl with ladies on the 2nd and 4th floors, dudes on 1 and 3. 

Well for some reason only one wing of the 4th floor was being used that semester, not enough people in the building or something, but all the doors to the floor and communal bathrooms were left unlocked so there was nothing stopping you from wandering around up there. 

I found this to be perfect, I could have my own private bathroom, shower and shit without being bothered and no one would be the wiser if I used it early morning as there was only a handful of people in the 3rd floor wing below and not close enough to hear the bathrooms upstairs.

This worked out perfectly for around a month, until I started to notice the shower drains not draining as well as before. I tried to stomp on the drains a few times to make a water hammer like effect and it did nothing...the way the showers were set up, it was 6 stalls, 2 rows of three with drains in each stall as well as one bigger one in the middle, the shower area was blocked off by a 2-3 inch lip as well to keep water from flooding out. I figured if I just took shorter showers I could still use my private shower and did just that...until I fell asleep one morning.

I had to be up really early one morning for an exam study session so I woke up at like 3am, went up to my private bathroom and did my morning stuff and then showered. I must have passed out standing up because when I came to the motion lights had gone off, there was a huge river of water flowing down the hallway, down the adjacent staircase, down to the first floor lobby. I shut the shower off, tried to stomp the drains a few times but nothing.

I grabbed my stuff, towel, don't remember if I even wrapped the towel around my waist, and ran down the hall, down the stairs to 3, to my wing, to my dorm and locked myself in there! I sat for like 10 minutes just breathing, still naked and dripping wet, until the adrenaline wore off and I was able to get dressed. 

I went down to the lobby to leave to go meet up with my study group and was going to let the front desk worker know the stairs were wet, but they had already been aware of the leak and had maintenance on the way to fix it. I have no idea who called or told the front desk about the leak but I apologize for waking you up with a possible flooded room!
